reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 依 preset 按鍵收到的觸控事件型別分辨「選取」與「儲存」——短按走 Preset Select、長按走 Preset Save，且互不觸發。關鍵情境條件：同一個 preset 按鍵上的兩種事件型別。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 的驗證對象是分辨能力本身，唯有在同一條 TC 內以兩種事件對照才成立——只驗其中一種，無法區分「正確分辨」與「兩種事件都做同一件事」的實作（§7）。各自的觸發門檻與結果由 033（短按 < 兩秒）、037（長按 > 兩秒）、034/038（各自的結果）覆蓋，本 leaf 不重複驗證（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Short and long press on a preset trigger different functions
tcs.test_item: Preset Select feature may utilize a single press event while Preset Save feature requires a long press event and HU shall be able to differentiate between selecting and storing a preset based on the touch event type recieved on the preset button
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Preset 2 holds a subscribed channel and preset 5 holds a different one
5. The HU is tuned to a channel held in no preset
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note the tuned channel number
2. Short press the preset 2 button
3. Read the tuned channel and the content of preset 2
4. Press and hold the preset 5 button for more than two seconds, then read the tuned channel and the content of preset 5
tcs.expected_result:
1. The starting channel is playing
2. The short press is identified as a Preset Select request
3. The HU is tuned to the channel held in preset 2 and the content of preset 2 is unchanged
4. The HU stays on the channel from step 3 and preset 5 now holds that channel in place of its previous content
